whyThisFilenameAndNotRowsJson: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/pf02/rows.json and rows.pf02-rhode-island-2026-09-05.json are earlier PF02 returns and are not overwritten. This shift also does not overwrite this lane's previous Delaware return; it is a separate file under a name unique to this branch and this cohort.
whatThisShiftReversed: The previous PF02 shift stopped all three Delaware families as BLOCKED_SOURCE on AES-256 encryption, concluding that this factory holds no code path that could build from an encrypted source. Every measurement in that return holds -- the four Delaware binaries really are AES-256 (V=5, R=6, StdCF), pdf-lib really has no security handler, and ignoreEncryption:true really does parse ciphertext and surface as "Expected instance of PDFDict, but got instance of undefined" -- but the conclusion was wrong. The factory solved this in early September: renderStrategy pikepdf_unlocked_derivative_then_official_form_finalizer, proven on five encrypted California forms in scripts/build-census-v1-ca-1203-4-set.mjs and carried to a terminal family on Maine's encrypted CR-218 in scripts/build-census-v1-me-seal-gen-set.mjs. Two of the three Delaware families are built on that pattern in this return.

familyExplicitlyNotBuilt.why: Left stopped on the previous shift's finding, which the Captain did not override: FORM-281 is a binary .doc and FORM-281E a .docx with legacy FORMTEXT/FORMCHECKBOX fields, the family binds no PDF at all, and Delaware Family Court publishes the whole family as Word. That needs an owner decision on a Word path, not a rescue. Nothing was built and nothing was converted.

reviewDerivativesInTheRepositoryWereNotB: data/rcap-all50/overlays/rescued-encrypted-pdfs/delaware-download-aspx-rescued.pdf (bc39abcda95beef0...) was not used and is bound by nothing here. Its digest appears in no committed source record and in no corpus-index entry. Every derivative this build read was generated at build time from the pinned bytes, proved equivalent, and deleted when the build ended.
setsNoVerdict: This lane does not verify its own packets. No PASS is issued here, rasterState is BUILT_RASTER_PENDING, and RASTER_PASS comes from the central workflow bound to the exact SHA-256 recorded in each row.

conditionalDocumentsBoundButNotExercised.officialTitle: Expungement Petition Form Additional Charges Extension Sheet
conditionalDocumentsBoundButNotExercised.conditionDescription: When charges exceed the table on the petition.
conditionalDocumentsBoundButNotExercised.whyTheConditionIsUnmetInTheseFixtures: Both fixtures are within the four printed rows of the petition's own table, so the manifest's condition is not met and a continuation sheet is not part of either packet. It is not delivered blank: a continuation sheet attached to a petition that has no continuation asserts that the petitioner has more charges than the petition lists. The reason this family does not simply build a five-charge fixture is on the paper -- the PROPOSED ORDER CIV_EXP_04_A also prints exactly four rows and Delaware publishes no continuation sheet for an order, so a packet above four charges would carry a complete list on the petition and an order that could not hold it. That is raised as a counsel question about the form set rather than answered here.

transport.why: the pinned official binary is an AES-256 encrypted PDF (V=5, R=6, StdCF) with an empty user password; pdf-lib has no security handler, so ignoreEncryption:true suppresses the throw and then parses ciphertext, which surfaces as "Expected instance of PDFDict, but got instance of undefined", and neither a census nor an ink audit is possible against those bytes directly

conditionalDocumentsBoundButNotExercised.whatThisBindingEstablishes: that the pinned official binary is held in this container, hashes to its declared digest, and opens and proves equivalent through the same transport as every rendered document; it establishes nothing about a packet, because this document is in neither packet

mapVersusFinalizerGateWasTested: The gate DEFECTS_NO_COUNTER_CAN_SEE `map-honest-writes-not` asks for was tested by removing one write from the field map -- primary_filing.Telephone -- and rebuilding. The family stopped with stopClass FINALIZER_WRITES_DISAGREE_WITH_THE_FIELD_MAP and wroteButTheMapDeclaresBlank ["Telephone"]. The map was restored and the rebuild reproduced the same canonical SHA-256 byte for byte.

twoFamiliesOneFilingCheck.why: DEFECTS_NO_COUNTER_CAN_SEE `two-families-one-filing`: two Alabama families rendered byte-identical page images to each other and nothing in the factory had ever compared two families. These two families share their required primary filing, CIV_EXP_02_A, and are the obvious place for that defect to recur.
twoFamiliesOneFilingCheck.measurement: All twelve delivered pages (two families x two fixtures x three pages) rasterised at 72 dpi with poppler pdftoppm and hashed. Twelve distinct SHA-256 values, no collision. The two canonical packets share 57 leading bytes, which is the PDF header and the opening of the first object.
